ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: The weekly (investor-cycle) momentum just crossed UP while price holds its 10-day average — the start of a new multi-month up-leg. A daily-overbought print here is the launch thrust, not a top, so this is a HOLD / ride, not a take-profit. The daily can still dip to its 10-day average (normal) — but the bigger investor cycle is early, with room left. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Hold / ride the fresh weekly up-leg; add on pullbacks toward the 10-day average rather than chasing the thrust. First warning would be the weekly momentum rolling back over.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum just crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 8 · daily cycle day 34).
ladder.synthesis_line: Daily is hot (RSI 52, day 34/42 — a dip is normal soon), but the weekly investor cycle just turned up — so this is HOLD / ride a new up-leg, not take-profits.
ladder.synthesis_line_zh: 日线偏热（RSI 52，周期第 34 天——短期回调属正常），但周线投资者周期刚刚向上转向——因此应持有 / 顺势新上行段，而非止盈。
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)

ladder.why_zh: 周线（投资者周期）动量刚刚向上交叉，且价格守住 10 日均线——这是新的多月上行段的起点。此处日线超买只是启动推力、并非见顶，因此应持有 / 顺势，而非止盈。日线仍可能回踩 10 日均线（属正常）——但更大的投资者周期尚处早期，仍有空间。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 持有 / 顺应新的周线上行段；在回踩 10 日均线时加仓，而非追高推力。首个预警将是周线动量重新掉头向下。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 8 周 · 日线周期第 34 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（顺势）：看多。

ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自买入区翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 +45/100）。
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).

detail.en: Mid-range composite and accumulation — no contrarian extension or washout edge here.
detail.zh: 综合分与吸筹均处中位 — 无逆向高位或超卖的边际。

caveat.en: Contrarian read — the INVERSE of the indicator's usual framing. Validated (display-only) that a high composite flags lower forward-63d returns (decile Spearman −0.88) and that rising 'whale accumulation' precedes under-performance (monthly IC t≈−3.9). Large-cap survivor sample; a tilt, not a trade.
caveat.zh: 逆向解读 — 与该指标常规用法相反。经验证（仅供展示）：高综合分预示未来63日回报更低（分位单调 Spearman −0.88），且“鲸鱼吸筹”上升反而领先跑输（月度 IC t≈−3.9）。样本为大盘幸存股；是倾斜而非交易信号。

squeeze.gloss: Compression → a move is loading; direction unconfirmed until it breaks.
squeeze.gloss_zh: 波动压缩——更大行情正在蓄势；突破前方向未定。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -6% · 极端 -19% · → 建议仓位 100%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
